description: Defines the CryptoHalAidl class implementing the ICrypto interface for Android DRM, including external dependencies, class methods, and internal members related to DRM plugin management.

classes.name: CryptoHalAidl
classes.description: Implements the ICrypto interface for Android DRM, managing DRM plugins and sessions.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks initialization status of the DRM plugin.

methods.name: isCryptoSchemeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given UUID scheme is supported.

methods.name: createPlugin
methods.description: Creates a DRM plugin with specified UUID and data.

methods.name: requiresSecureDecoderComponent
methods.description: Checks if a secure decoder component is required for a MIME type.

methods.name: notifyResolution
methods.description: Notifies the plugin of video resolution changes.

methods.name: setMediaDrmSession
methods.description: Sets the current media DRM session.

methods.name: setHeap
methods.description: Associates a memory heap with the DRM plugin.
